releaseNotes: CRITICAL Arabic fix: XER files saved by Arabic-locale P6 installations (Windows-1256) now load with correct Arabic text everywhere - reports, dashboards, Project Data and Excel output - on any computer, regardless of its system language.
Reports are written as true UTF-8 with an explicit charset declaration; Arabic project names, WBS names and activity names are byte-verified against the original file.
Ribbon icons for WBS Style, WBS to HTML and HTML Dashboard are now included in the installed package (they were missing from previous installers).

Fresh visual pass: Windows 11 rounded window corners, a proper title-bar close button with hover/pressed states, consistent title typography, and darker secondary text that meets readability contrast targets in both Light and Dark themes.
Logs window: clearer header, more readable log font and layout; Open Logs Folder / Copy Latest Log Path / Refresh unchanged.
WBS HTML: calmer toolbar buttons with hover and focus states and a pill-style Data Date label; the P6 WBS hierarchy colors are unchanged.
New release gates: every published installer is executed on a fresh machine with the update endpoint offline, and the exact public download bytes are re-downloaded and executed after publication.
